'''Gottlegoob''' was an object<ref name="JK" /> located in the [[Gottlegoob system/Legends|eponymous star system]] within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point during her tenure as [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was enthralled by a report on an initiative to feed hungry [[Unidentified Gottlegoob species|natives]] on Gottlegoob.<ref name="JK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gottlegoob was first mentioned in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="JK" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Gottlegoob system/Legends|Gottlegoob star system]] and the location itself in grid square O-20.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
